---
title: "Community Overview"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../params.R")
library(tidyverse)
ghg_emissions <- read_csv("../ghg_emissions.csv") |>
  mutate(entity = factor(entity, levels = c("hampshire_college", "municipal", "amherst_college", "umass", "community")))
```

```{r}
amherst_cols <- c( "#2E7D8C","#8B2635", "#5A7A5E", "#C9A040", "#5B6F7E", "#B08050")

df <- ghg_emissions |>
  filter(input_year == 2022) |>
  group_by(entity) |>
  summarize(emissions = sum(total_mtco2e, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(emissions) 

plot_ly(
  data = df,
  labels = ~entity,
  values = ~emissions,
  type = "pie",
  sort = FALSE,
  marker = list(colors = amherst_cols),
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "<b>%{label}</b><br>",
    "Emissions: %{value:,.1f} MTCO2e<br>",
    "Share: %{percent}<extra></extra>"
  )
)
```
